post.description: Create a new SocialVerification record and return the provider's authorization URI for the given connector.

redirectUri.description: The URI to redirect the user after the social authorization is completed.

state.description: The state parameter to pass to the social connector.

200.description: The social authorization URI has been successfully generated.

verificationId.description: The unique verification ID of the newly created SocialVerification record. The `verificationId` is required when verifying the social authorization response.

404.description: The social connector is not found.

500.description: Connector error. Failed to generate the social authorization URI.

post.description: Verify the social authorization response data and get the user's identity data from the social provider. For QR code sign-in capable connectors, the `connectorData` must be exactly `{ "qrCodeSessionId": "<verificationId>" }`; the session must have been confirmed by a qualifying WeChat scan event and is consumed atomically.

verificationId.description: The ID of the social verification record. Optional for Google one tap login, as it does not have a pre-created social verification record in session.

connectorData.description: Arbitrary data returned by the social provider to complete the verification process. For QR code sign-in capable connectors, only `{ "qrCodeSessionId": "<verificationId>" }` is accepted.

qrCodeSessionId.description: Dev feature. The ID of the confirmed QR code session owned by the current interaction. Required (as the sole key of `connectorData`) only for QR code sign-in capable connectors.

200.description: The social authorization response has been successfully verified.

verificationId.description: The unique verification ID of the SocialVerification record. This ID is required when identifying the user in the current interaction.

400.description: The social authorization response is invalid or cannot be verified.

404.description: The social connector is not found.

422.description: Dev features are disabled, or the connector does not support QR code sign-in.

500.description: Connector error. Failed to verify the social authorization response or fetch the user info from the social provider.
